title: Roman Battle Galleons
content: What if Rome never fell and they went on to conquer the world with motorized battle galleys? This concept plays out inKirk Mitchell's science fiction series,Procurator.This was one of the preliminary sketches.The final painting was a wraparound cover of a sand galley, an open-topped troop carrier, battle platform, and siege weapon built along the lines of a trireme.-----Previous post:Alternate History
